criterion: A/B/AB joint event (same legacy U04 event, not four-state correctness)

recipe.ranking: positive-v-negative different fit parent pairs; 0.2 pair logistic + same BCE; different supervision contract

limitations: Bank reused, not an independent confirmation

paired J_star bootstrap holds sample-selected oracle threshold fixed; diagnostic descriptive interval only
head-dev split cannot undo frozen-encoder training exposure
